The attack activation is '**Action** - {r}, {t}: **Attack**' and was authored as a PITCH of 2 cards. Pitching is not tapping, and two is not one: it charged two cards the text never asks for and never exhausted the ally, so the attack was repeatable. Same substitution as kayo_strong_arm. TAP_SELF is checkable (can_pay is false while tapped) and activation_cost 1 is the {r}.

NOT IMPLEMENTED: 'until end of turn, effects controlled by opponents don't trigger when their attacks hit'. That is trigger SUPPRESSION scoped to a player -- the engine can add triggers and can gate them on conditions, but nothing can switch off a class of trigger belonging to someone else. The attack activation and Watery Grave are intact.
